triggers.message_status_update.descripti: Triggers when a message status changes (sent, delivered, read).
triggers.message_status_update.props.set:
**Setup Instructions:**

1. Copy the **Webhook URL** below.
2. Go to your [Kapso dashboard](https://app.kapso.ai) and open your WhatsApp number settings.
3. Paste the URL as your **Webhook destination URL**.
4. Message status updates will now trigger this flow.

**Webhook URL:**
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
triggers.message_status_update.props.sta: Only trigger for a specific status. Leave as All to trigger for any status change.
